metadata.title: 1,000 Production AWS Architectures Dataset
metadata.author: Senior AWS Solutions Architect
metadata.description: Comprehensive reference dataset of 1,000 unique production-grade AWS architecture blueprints spanning 18 industries, covering high availability, serverless, HPC, edge, AI/ML, FinTech, healthcare, and multi-region patterns.

architectures.title: Core Banking Real-time Ledger - Serverless (Event-Driven)
architectures.use_case_summary: Production deployment for Fintech & Banking: Multi-region active-active ledger processing financial transactions with sub-millisecond ACID guarantees and immutable audit trails. Implemented using a event-driven serverless design pattern to achieve strict SOC 2 Type II compliance and guaranteed Multi-Region Active-Active (RPO=0, RTO<30s) SLA.
data_flow: 1. Ingestion: Client traffic and sensors connect via Amazon Aurora Multi-Region or API boundary protected by AWS WAF & Shield.
2. Routing & Decoupling: Requests routed via Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables into decoupled asynchronous queues/event buses.
3. Core Compute: Processed by AWS KMS utilizing stateless microservices.
4. Persistence & Caching: State maintained in AWS CloudTrail with Redis/DAX caching layer.
5. Analytics & Archival: Change data capture streamed to Amazon EventBridge for long-term analytical query and compliance audit trails.
